|living=ns}}'''Mistress Asher''' was a merchant traveling through [[Canluum]] who was also a wilder.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Asher, Mistress|Asher}} She was staying at [[The Gates of Heaven]] where she encountered [[Moiraine Damodred]] along with six other [[Aes Sedai]].{{ref/book|0|7}} Because she was past middle-age and displaying grey hair, the Aes Sedai mutually agreed that she was too old to become a [[novice]].{{ref||Asher}}{{ref/book|0|7}}
